# ESLint → oxlint rule mapping

<!-- Generated by `npm run audit:oxlint`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Effective rules of the `.` (JS) and `./typescript` presets — `@eslint/js` recommended,
`rules.js`, typescript-eslint recommended and the TS overrides — checked against
oxlint 1.88.0. Options are checked by loading them into oxlint, which rejects
options that don't match the rule's schema.

| | logic | stylistic | total |

| native | 135 | 1 | 136 |
| via JS plugin | 0 | 2 | 2 |

Deprecated in ESLint (enabled): 41 — of which stylistic: 37.

## Unsupported logic rules

- `consistent-this`
- `dot-notation` — only as type-aware `typescript/dot-notation`
- `no-dupe-args` — oxlint's parser reports it as a syntax error in .mjs, .ts
- `no-octal` — oxlint's parser reports it as a syntax error in .mjs, .ts
- `no-restricted-modules` — enabled without options: a no-op in ESLint; ESLint: deprecated since v7.0.0; replaced by eslint-plugin-n → no-restricted-require
- `no-restricted-syntax` — enabled without options: a no-op in ESLint
- `no-return-await` — ESLint: deprecated since v8.46.0
- `no-undef-init`
